description: This line plot, titled "BBQ", illustrates the accuracy of four different models—labeled "Squared Exponential", "Tanh", "ELU", and "LLaMA-2-chat-7B"—as a function of the number of demonstrations, which is plotted on the x-axis labeled "#Demonstrations" and ranges from 0 to 1500 on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy", ranges from approximately 45 to 55 on a linear scale. The "Squared Exponential" model is represented by a solid dark blue line with circular markers, starting at an accuracy of approximately 53.5 at 0 demonstrations and rising to a peak of about 56.5 before leveling off near 56. The "Tanh" model is shown as a solid dark blue line with circular markers, beginning at about 49.5 and remaining relatively flat near 49.5 throughout the range. The "ELU" model is depicted as a solid dark blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 47.5 and remaining nearly constant near 47.5. The "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" model is represented by a dashed pink line with circular markers, maintaining a constant accuracy of approximately 46.5 across the entire x-axis range. A legend in the upper right corner identifies each line, and a gray shaded bar beneath the x-axis axis label indicates the x-axis represents "#Demonstrations".
